label: Diagram 5.3
caption: Diagram 5.3 Internal wall type C
description: The drawing carries the title "Diagram 5.3 Internal wall type C" in a shaded band across the top. Inside a plain bordered frame there is a single vertical drawing, identified by the word "SECTION" printed at the lower right corner. The section is a tall, narrow rectangle representing a wall in cross-section. It is made up of four stacked rectangular blocks, each filled with a diagonal cross-hatch pattern of intersecting lines. The four hatched blocks are separated from one another by three thin horizontal layers, each drawn as a pair of closely spaced parallel lines running the full width of the wall. The parts relate as a continuous vertical column, the hatched blocks and the thin double-lined layers alternating from top to bottom. No dimensions, scale bar, or other labels appear within the drawing.
